description: Lists the decisions waiting for the owner (posts, pictures, pages, replies, ideas…), most urgent first: each with its id, what it is, its line, its kind, about how many minutes it takes and its options (an option that needs words says so; a storyboard round also lists its boards with what each costs in tokens). Cards whose moment passed are in the freezer, not here: freezer_read reads them and freezer_take_out puts one back. Read one whole (the draft, the reply and its thread, the audit, the message, the page, the pictures) with card_read before answering it with answer_decision.

limit.description: How many to list, the most urgent first; every one when left out.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: list_decisions
title: List what needs the owner
